question: On the unit round S3, what are the declared rough/Hodge/Lichnerowicz spectral conventions, degeneracies, exceptional modes, scalar-derived normalization shifts, and exact cumulative sector counts for scalar, transverse-vector, and TT-tensor harmonic sectors?

upstream_results.role: pins the unit-S3 scalar-derived gradient and tracefree-Hessian convention without promoting it to a full SVT basis
pins the prior zonal scalar convention and its explicit boundary that zonal convolution is not full SVT or HDA

primary_sources.source: L. Lindblom, N. W. Taylor and F. Zhang, Scalar, Vector and Tensor Harmonics on the Three-Sphere, Gen. Rel. Grav. 49 (2017) 139, arXiv:1709.08020
primary_sources.used_for: unit-S3 scalar/vector/tensor Laplace, divergence, trace and normalization conventions including exceptional low-mode ranges
primary_sources.not_used_for: a complete numerical basis realization, Gaunt coefficients, ADM constraints, or a physical prediction

primary_sources.source: A. Higuchi, Symmetric Tensor Spherical Harmonics on the N-Sphere and Their Application to the de Sitter Group SO(N,1), J. Math. Phys. 28 (1987) 1553; erratum J. Math. Phys. 43 (2002) 6385
primary_sources.not_used_for: the repository-local cutoff counts or any gravitational constraint algebra

declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3 with Ric_ab=2 gamma_ab and scalar curvature 6
declared_conventions.riemann_and_lichnerowicz_definition: R_ikjl=gamma_ij gamma_kl-gamma_il gamma_kj and (Delta_L h)_ij=-D^2 h_ij+R_i^k h_kj+R_j^k h_ik-2 R_ikjl h^kl; for tracefree h this is Delta_rough h+6h
declared_conventions.full_label_meaning: FULL_SVT means that scalar, transverse-vector and TT spectral sectors are all present in one bookkeeping packet; it does not assert explicit bases, chirality resolution, Gaunt data or a completeness proof
declared_conventions.scalar_sector: n>=0; lambda_n=n(n+2); rough Delta_0=-D^2 eigenvalue lambda_n; degeneracy d_0=(n+1)^2
declared_conventions.transverse_vector_sector: n>=1; D^aV_a=0; rough Delta_1=-D^2 eigenvalue lambda_n-1; Hodge Delta_H=Delta_1+2 eigenvalue lambda_n+1; combined degeneracy d_1=2n(n+2)
declared_conventions.tt_tensor_sector: n>=2; D^aT_ab=0=T^a_a; rough Delta_2=-D^2 eigenvalue lambda_n-2; declared Delta_L=Delta_2+6 on tracefree symmetric tensors has eigenvalue lambda_n+4; combined degeneracy d_2=2(n-1)(n+3)
declared_conventions.scalar_derived_vector: G_a=lambda_n^(-1/2)D_aQ for n>=1; norm one; rough eigenvalue lambda_n-2; Hodge eigenvalue lambda_n
declared_conventions.scalar_derived_tf_hessian: S_ab=D_aD_bQ+(lambda_n/3)gamma_abQ; norm squared (2/3)lambda_n(lambda_n-3); normalized for n>=2; rough eigenvalue lambda_n-6; declared Lichnerowicz eigenvalue lambda_n
declared_conventions.vector_derived_tensor: A_ab=D_aV_b+D_bV_a for transverse unit V; norm squared 2(lambda_n-3); normalized for n>=2; rough eigenvalue lambda_n-5; declared Lichnerowicz eigenvalue lambda_n+1
declared_conventions.exceptional_modes: n=0 scalar is constant with vanishing gradient; n=1 scalar-derived TF Hessian vanishes; n=1 transverse vectors are Killing and their symmetrized gradients vanish; TT tensor sector starts at n=2

exact_plan: hash-verify both prior harmonic results and retain their non-HDA boundaries
record scalar, transverse-vector and TT-tensor eigenvalue/degeneracy theorems as source-pinned guards, then verify their transport against an independently fixed low-mode table

record gradient scalar, tracefree-Hessian scalar, and symmetrized-gradient transverse-vector norm and rough/Lichnerowicz identities as source-pinned guards, then verify only their algebraic consequences
verify declared n=0 and n=1 low-mode arithmetic while retaining constant/Killing/absence statements as theorem guards with explicit allowed ranges
derive sector cumulative counts and leading cubic Weyl coefficients at the declared cutoffs
keep rough, Hodge and declared Lichnerowicz Laplacians as distinct named expressions and test their shifts explicitly
leave explicit basis functions, Gaunt data, ADM constraints, HDA/Jacobi/BFV and all physical outputs null

decision_table.condition: both upstream pins and all spectral, normalization, exceptional-mode, count and convention-separation identities pass
decision_table.meaning: only the source-pinned spectral convention transport and exact arithmetic are retained; no completeness theorem is produced by the runner
